function_declarations.name: gtm_consultation
function_declarations.description: Free EPIC audit using Shashwat Ghosh's EPIC framework

function_declarations.name: epic_audit
function_declarations.description: Get EPIC framework scores for your GTM strategy

business_model.description: Optional. How you charge: software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management. For a business that is not a software subscription, the product-led steps become a low-risk first step the buyer can take without a full project, and no trial or sign-up steps are given

product_description.description: Optional. One or two sentences on what you sell and to whom. Read for the sector, the business model and the buyer's function, so the steps fit your product

industry.description: Optional. Your industry or what you sell (for example logistics tech, fintech, telecom, cybersecurity). Names your buyers' roles, partner types and measures in the steps

company_name.description: Optional. Your company or product name, repeated in the answer

acv_usd.description: Optional. Average contract value per year in US dollars (for example 42000)

deal_cycle_days.description: Optional. Days from first touch to closed-won (for example 120). A long cycle adds the review steps to the plan

tam_accounts.description: Optional. Number of addressable accounts (for example 2500)

nrr_percent.description: Optional. Net revenue retention in percent (for example 108)

current_channels.description: Optional. What you do today (content, outbound, events, partnerships, PLG, community). The first steps start from it

protocol: MCP Streamable HTTP: POST JSON-RPC 2.0 requests (initialize, tools/list, tools/call) to api_endpoint
